nativeBlocker.classification: Review semantic/contract-mapping error propagated by Revision; host coverage gate correctly prevented release. The observed stop is not an externalization/version-increment crash.
nativeBlocker.causalLimit: This run proves the erroneous recommendation and resulting declarations, not that model capability alone or context length alone caused the mistake.

independentObserverFindings.finding: Penalty sounds may overlap gameover for 0–0.2 seconds, but a separate lifecycle rule prohibits any cross-state residual sound except gameover. The playing→gameover table also permits penalty tails.
independentObserverFindings.downstreamImpact: Implementation must choose whether to preserve or cut the same penalty tail.

independentObserverFindings.finding: unsupported overlay on orientation/size failure is claimed to naturally pause simulation through rAF invisibility. An in-page overlay does not establish background-tab/page-hidden conditions.
independentObserverFindings.downstreamImpact: The simulation/clock may keep advancing while input is disabled; stop/resume behavior has no justified technical contract.
independentObserverFindings.classification: Unsupported platform inference and semantic review miss.
independentObserverFindings.sourceInterpretation: MDN describes background-tab/hidden-frame rAF behavior and document visibility. Inferring an in-page orientation overlay from that behavior is unsupported.

independentObserverFindings.finding: Reported 60/120-second all-caught scenario scores are spawned-fruit counts multiplied by score per catch. The generation stream does not model fall completion, basket motion or catches at those timestamps.
independentObserverFindings.downstreamImpact: The evidence supports generated-fruit potential score, not the described at-time catch outcome. This is a claim/evidence mismatch, not demonstrated arithmetic failure.
independentObserverFindings.classification: Evidence scope overstated; native semantic review miss.
